summary: This is a closure review. The authors have addressed the two prior required items: (1) they added an artifact-cited aggregate difficulty-label summary for the n=200 confirmatory intents (easy=20, medium=80, hard=60, very_hard=40) with the task_manifest SHA-256 cited, and (2) they included an auditable exemplar of the single repaired episode (task_id task-000137) reporting the validator.violation_codes (["MISSING_REQUIRED_COMMAND"]), the deterministic Insertion repair applied, and pointers to the pre/post repair traces in execution/scoring/task-000137-guarded.json. Preregistration fidelity, archival artifacts, execution accounting, and the small-discordant-count exact-test choice are adequately documented and justified. Threats-to-validity (near-ceiling baseline, single LLM, synthetic task bank, emulator limits) are explicitly discussed. No unresolved required revisions remain. I recommend acceptance for finalisation.
optional_revisions: Optionally add a single short sentence in the Abstract that the confirmatory bank is synthetic/curated (for quick scanner clarity).
Optionally include a one-line labeled excerpt or brief description of the initial master prompt in the Disclosure Statement if space permits (the SHA-256 is already present).
Optionally report per-difficulty-stratum success rates (easy/medium/hard/very_hard) in a small table or parenthetical sentence to aid readers assessing task difficulty vs. outcome.
